\section*{S1. Selection protocol}

The inclusion criteria I1--I3 and exclusion codes E1--E7 (main text, Section~1) were fixed before any
query was run. All queries were run on 2026-11-08. The listings show titles only, so records were identified by
title, and abstracts and full texts were read at screening. Table~\ref{tab:s-search} gives each query group; the
per-record logs (every listing URL, every title hit with its decision and exclusion code, and the
full-text tables) accompany this supplement as \texttt{search/s1-cvf.md}, \texttt{search/s2-ml.md},
\texttt{search/s3-aaai-journals-arxiv-snowball.md}, \texttt{search/g-gap.md} and
\texttt{search/manual-pdfs.md}.

\begin{table}[h]
\centering\footnotesize\setlength{\tabcolsep}{3pt}
\caption{Query groups, queries and counts. Identified: title hits screened. Full text: papers read in full.
Included: methods meeting I1--I3 in that query group, before de-duplication.}\label{tab:s-search}
\begin{tabular}{@{}l>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{3.6cm}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{5.4cm}rrr@{}}
\toprule
Query group & Sources & Query & Identified & Full text & Included \\
\midrule
S1 & CVPR 2022--26, ICCV 2023/25, ECCV 2022/24 (official CVF/ECVA listings) &
  Case-insensitive title regex \texttt{distil|knowledge transfer|teacher|student} & 656 & 96 & 37 \\
S2 & NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR 2022--26; TMLR (official listings) &
  Title match \texttt{distill|knowledge transfer|teacher} & 985 & 130 & 36 \\
S3 & AAAI 2022--26, TPAMI, IJCV (Crossref, 2022-01-01 to 2026-11-08); arXiv cs.CV/cs.LG from 2025;
  snowballing from 24 papers' comparison tables &
  Six Crossref title queries (distillation, distill, distilling, distilled, ``teacher student'',
  ``knowledge transfer''); arXiv abstract query ``knowledge distillation'' AND (CIFAR-100 OR ImageNet) &
  552 & 84 & 39 \\
\midrule
Second pass & The same listings and APIs &
  Broadened title terms (teach, student, mimic, soft label, dark knowledge, logit, temperature
  scaling); re-check of 29 cited works no query group had included & 445 & 13 & +2 \\
Manual & Papers the query groups could not access & Retrieved by hand; 2 remain unreadable & -- & 15 & +6 \\

The three query groups give 106 distinct methods after de-duplication (six were found twice). The second pass
added CTKD and the projector study (SRD); two coordinator rulings removed LTKD (E4: CIFAR-100-LT only) and
PE-BKD (analysis only). Manual retrieval added six methods, for 112. Two papers remain unassessable because no
full text was found. An independent spot-check drew 22 inclusions and 30 exclusions; among the 20 of each whose
full text was accessible it found no errors after adjudication (2 inclusions and 10 exclusions could not be
read).
